messages:
maria: Heads up — Velociti sent back the RFI, they flagged 3 'exceptions' we need to answer by EOD Friday. They want a capability matrix CSV + the filled security questionnaire.
omar: copying the exceptions here: 1) HSM in private deployments 2) FedRAMP status for Dedicated 3) Cost model for caching and KV-store.
jess: can you paste the exact lines from the customer doc? need to map to our standard answers.
maria: pasted snippets: 
> Q12: Do you support customer-managed HSM for on-prem/private?
> Q24: Are any of your hosted/dedicated offerings FedRAMP authorized?
> Q38: Describe pricing for caching, prefix/KV cache and per-token vs per-request billing.
liam: quick answers before we craft formal text: HSM — Private supports KMS/HSM integrations via customer KMS and on-prem HSM appliances; Dedicated in-cloud can integrate with cloud KMS, but we don't host customer HSM in hosted multitenant. FedRAMP — not authorized; roadmap/partners note. Pricing — hosted per-token, Dedicated reserved capacity months + per-token for overage; caching reduces tokens billed (we can include example).
security: I'll prepare the security questionnaire snippets. For HSM we need to include our integration diagram and the KMS/HSM supported vendors list. Can someone attach the diagram PNG and the KMS matrix?
jess: I have a 1-page diagram — uploading to Google Drive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-example-link (internal only). Use this language for Q12: "Redwood supports customer-managed key material via integrations with cloud KMS providers and can be configured to use customer HSM appliances in Private/on-prem deployments; our hosted multitenant service does not directly host customer HSM appliances." Keep it concise.
omar: For FedRAMP Q24 we should be explicit: "Not FedRAMP authorized as of <2026-03-20>. We can pursue high-impact customer engagements under a dedicated roadmap; contact AE for enterprise compliance plan."
maria: For pricing Q38 can we include a short worked example? e.g., "Customer A gets Dedicated with 4x A100s reserved, baseline cost $X/month; cache reduces billed token count by ~30% for typical chat workloads; overage billed at $Y/1k tokens." Liam — can you fill numbers with placeholders we can later replace?
liam: Draft numbers: baseline commit $25k/month for 4 GPUs, overage $0.60/1k tokens, hosted gen $0.03/1k tokens (example). I'll mark them as estimates.
jess: Also need capability matrix CSV. Columns: capability, hosted (yes/no), dedicated (yes/no), private (yes/no), notes. I'll generate CSV and attach to the RFI bundle.
maria: Sales-bot — can you remind the AE about EOD Friday and attach the list of docs they need to sign off?
sales-bot: Reminder: Velociti RFI — sign-off checklist due EOD Friday. Required: capability_matrix.csv, security_questionnaire_filled.pdf, HSM_integration_diagram.png, pricing_estimate.xlsx. @maria @omar @jess
omar: OK — action items: jess (diagram + capability CSV), security (questionnaire snippets + vendor list), liam (pricing worksheet + example calc), maria (final edits + upload). I'll draft the reply text for the RFI after we collect artifacts.
jess: Upload CSV in thread: 
```
capability,hosted,dedicated,private,notes
SSO,yes,yes,yes,Supports SAML/OIDC across deployments
Customer HSM,no,limited,yes,Hosted: no direct HSM; Dedicated integrates with cloud KMS; Private supports on-prem HSM
Streaming,yes,yes,yes,Token streaming and chunked responses
KV caching,yes,yes,yes,Automatic prefix/KV caching; behavior configurable per-route
Quantization support,yes,yes,yes,Mixed precision and INT8 quantization across runtimes
```
maria: Nice. For the formal RFI response we'll need to call out the "exceptions" section and provide remediation or programmatic commitments — e.g., roadmap for FedRAMP. Keep tone factual.
security: Uploading vendor list: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, Thales Luna, Utimaco. Will mark which ones are validated in Private.
liam: Pricing worksheet uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-price-estimate-example (internal). Use estimate placeholders; legal will remove before public sharing if needed.
maria: Draft reply (I'll paste then you all can edit): "Thanks Velociti — please see attached capability matrix and the filled security questionnaire. Short answers to exceptions: 1) HSM — Private supports customer HSM; Dedicated integrates with cloud KMS; hosted multitenant cannot host customer HSM appliances. 2) FedRAMP — Redwood is not FedRAMP-authorized as of 2026-03-20; we offer dedicated roadmap and partner-assisted hosting options for regulated workloads. 3) Caching/pricing — see attached pricing_estimate.xlsx and worked example; prefix/KV caching reduces billed tokens and can be configured per-deployment"
jess: Edits: add sentence linking to the integration diagram and contact for SRE to run a short tech deep-dive.
omar: Looks good. I'll add an explicit ask: "If you want, we can schedule a 60-min architecture review with our infra team this week to validate HSM integration approach."
maria: Great — can we aim to upload final bundle by 5pm PT Thursday so AE can review?
security: I'll finish questionnaire by 3pm PT Thursday.
liam: I'll finalize numbers by noon Thursday.
jess: CSV + diagram done. Uploading now.
maria: Thanks team — we'll reconvene in thread once the AE has sign-off.
sales-bot: Ticket updated: RFI-5987 assigned to @maria, due 2026-03-26 17:00 PT.
